identity.text: A Twin Cities math clubMatheapolisWe meet around a table in a coffee shop or a brewery in the Twin Cities and work through something together - a paper, a proof, a proof assistant, a puzzle with a strange answer. Dates go up on Meetup; most of the arguing happens in the chat between meetings.There is no syllabus, no reading list to keep up with, and no current focus. What the club is pulling on is decided in its own chat, and some of the threads open there are further down this page. Bring a question; you don't need a field. Formerly the Minneapolis Mathematics Book Club.Join Our GroupView Schedule
